    Local-density invariance between finite indecomposable skeletons #

    Two complete duplicate-free skeletons of the same finite-dimensional module category have equivalent label types. Isomorphic represented modules have the same projective status and the same number of indecomposable occurrences in a minimal right almost-split source, so their right-tau local densities agree. Consequently the total local density is independent of the chosen skeleton.
